fee_notes: Royalty: greater of 5% gross sales or $1,000/mo (9% under Franchise Option Program; 2% or $1,000/mo whichever greater for first 24mo under Conversion Franchise Program). Brand Fund: greater of 2% or $500/mo. Tech fee: $500/mo new franchisee, $300/mo for adjacent contiguous territory existing franchisee.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee The greater of: (a) 5% of Gross Sales of your Franchised Business from the prior month; or (b) $1,000 per month. Brand Fund Fee The greater of: (a) 2% of the Gross Sales of your Franchised Business from the prior month; or (b)$500 per month. Technology Fee $300-$500 per month.
